title: Cause of Kranji Crescent Warehouse Fire on 19 February and Exposure of Pollutants to Nearby Residents
what_it_is: Cause of Kranji Crescent Warehouse Fire on 19 February and Exposure of Pollutants to Nearby Residents

sections.label: General Waste Disposal Facility fire
sections.summary: A licensed General Waste Disposal Facility caught fire on 19 February, and investigations into licensing and fire safety compliance are ongoing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The site that caught fire on 19 February is occupied by a General Waste Disposal Facility.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: It is licensed to receive industrial and commercial waste for sorting prior to recycling and disposal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The facility contained materials such as paper, plastics, glass, scrap metal, wood waste and e-waste, but it is not licensed to store toxic industrial waste or hazardous substances.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Investigations by the National Environment Agency (NEA) and the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) are ongoing to ascertain whether the facility had adhered to the relevant licensing and fire safety requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The facility is around two kilometres away from the nearest residences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Based on NEA's ambient air quality monitoring network, the air quality in the West region remained within the normal range throughout the four-day duration of the fire.

sections.label: Six inspections since 2021
sections.summary: Six inspections were conducted at this premises since 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For this particular premises, they actually did six inspections since 2021.

sections.label: Four Fire Hazard Abatement Notices
sections.summary: Four Fire Hazard Abatement Notices were issued for this premises to rectify non-compliance issues such as fire exit obstruction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Where there are non-compliance, these would be issued out.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, for this premises, I think they issued four Fire Hazard Abatement Notices, which is actually a warning to ask them to rectify some non-compliance issues like obstruction of fire exit door or fire extinguisher or faulty fire exit sign.
